items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: John Cotter made the arrangements for us, and Jimmy Forrest and Lucille Agers really broke it up.

ctx.x: And we had to hit by 15 minutes. So the result of that trip, the band didn't do so hot, at the Apollo. The year we played the Apollo Theater, with Louis Jordan in 1945, the band was a riot.
But your lifesaver on that trip was Lucille Agers.
You mean this last trip. The '46 trip?
